title: Dead Field
wikitext:
[[image:Dead_Field.jpg|thumb|The Dead Field]]
'''The Dead Field''' is the name of a decrepit and abandoned farm in northern [[Silverpine Forest]]. The nature and number of the farm's former inhabitants are unknown. Recently the Field has become a base for the [[Rot Hide]] [[gnolls]], servants of the [[Scourge]]. It is unknown what the Scourge plans at the farm, but the increasing numbers of the gnolls suggests imminent military action. 

A reconnaissance mission undertaken by the Deathstalkers passed through the field on their mission through northern Silverpine, noting the presence of the Scourge at the farm. Repeated small assaults by the [[Forsaken]] on the Dead Field have been unsuccessful because of the arrival of a [[banshee]] known as [[Nightlash]]. The banshee appears when the Rot Hides under her command are attacked.
